Messages.Body:
I currently have a deck with Harbringers of Skulls and Salubri and have a
question about this location.

I state that when i "borrow" another players vampire and tap the castle i
take more blood from that vampire than my vampire need.
That meens that if i borrow a fuull Inner Circle with 11/11, and i tap the
castle, i can move 10 blood to my 5/7 vampire with the result
that my vampire is at 7/7 and the IC is at 1/11 and there is 8 more blood in
the blood bank.

My oponent complain at state that i can only take the 2 i need to get full.

Who is correct?

Daniel Eriksson aka walkertullaris
Sweden
